remarks: Enjoy this spacious and beautifully remodeled Townhome. Designed with a contemporary flair and a touch of an open floor plan. This 4-level living brings out the best from the vaulted ceiling, spiral staircase, fireplace and more. It features a remodeled eat-in kitchen, new 2.5 baths and flooring on the main level. Wonderful Living/Dining area with an inviting woodburning fireplace and door leading to a private deck. Two bedrooms plus a cheerful loft area (a perfect home/office set up) Spacious primary bedroom with vaulted ceiling, palladio window and the private stunning bath with double sinks, granite counter and marble shower stall. Two attached garages with easy interior access to a large den. Cozy complex with the conveniences of Glenbrook Train Station, Highway and Downtown. Minutes to our beautiful Stamford beaches and parks.
